name: YouTube Music Break Music
author: KHost
description: Plays break music through the YouTube Music app installed in Microsoft Edge on this machine (Windows only).

settings.label: Playlist (YouTube Music link — blank resumes whatever the app has loaded)
Open YouTube Music if it is not already running
Fade out when a singer starts, in milliseconds (0 cuts at once)
Press play again when YouTube Music pauses by itself ("Are you still there?")
Edge profile folder for YouTube Music (blank uses KHost's own under Local AppData)
